name: Segundo Cérebro
description: Runs a second-brain routine inside Obsidian: creates the daily note, delivers a morning task briefing, takes a spoken check-in at night, and keeps the wiki structured as a map rather than a dumping ground. In Portuguese, and dependent on you actually keeping your notes in Obsidian.
